blocks.original_text:
- name: guide_daily_metrics
      description: Daily guide-by-day spine from guide creation through the build date with left-joined usage metrics.
      grain: One row per guide_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- From guide info, derive created_on as the calendar day of created_at; keep guide_id and guide_name. - Build a guide-by-day spine by joining the calendar spine where date_day falls between created_on and the warehouse current date (inclusive at both ends). - For each (guide_id, date_day) in the spine, left join daily metrics where occurred_on equals date_day and guide_id matches. - Output date_day, guide_id, guide_name, count_accounts, and count_visitors exactly as in sources. - Missing metric rows are not backfilled; if no match exists, metric fields remain NULL. - No aggregation, de-duplication, or ordering is applied; duplicate source rows propagate as-is. - The upper bound (current date) is evaluated at model run time using the warehouse clock.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date in the spine from guide creation through the build date; join key to daily metrics by occurred_on.
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier from guide info; key for the spine and the metrics join.
      - name: guide_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide name from guide info at build time; not historically versioned.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily account count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily visitor count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.

blocks.original_text:
- name: page
      description: Core page dimension with latest page attributes joined to aggregated event metrics
      grain: One row per page_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- Build event metrics from staging.stg_pendo__page_event grouped by page_id: - Distinct visitor count. - Distinct account count. - Total pageviews as the sum of num_events (null values do not contribute). - Total event records counted across all rows. - First and last pageview timestamps as the earliest and latest occurred_at. - Visitor averages: - Average minutes per distinct visitor = total num_minutes divided by the distinct visitor count. - Average pageviews per distinct visitor = total num_events divided by the distinct visitor count. - When the distinct visitor count is zero, these averages are not computed. - Left join these metrics to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on page_id. - Apply final handling: - Counts and sums default to 0 when there are no matching events. - Averages are rounded to 3 decimal places and default to 0 when no visitors. - First and last pageview timestamps remain null when there are no matching events. - Output includes all columns from latest_page plus the metrics; one row per page_id present in latest_page.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique page identifier and join key; exactly one row per page_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest page name from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Page creation timestamp from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who created the page from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: is_dirty
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating unsaved changes in latest page info
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Group identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who last updated the page from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: valid_through
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Validity end timestamp of the latest page record snapshot
      - name: latest_page_index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Index of the latest page record in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct visitors for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct accounts for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: sum_pageviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total pageviews from num_events; 0 if no events
      - name: count_pageview_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total event records for the page; 0 if no events
      - name: first_pageview_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at for the page; NULL if no events
      - name: last_pageview_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at for the page; NULL if no events
      - name: avg_visitor_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per distinct visitor rounded to 3 decimals; 0 if no visitors
      - name: avg_visitor_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average pageviews per distinct visitor rounded to 3 decimals; 0 if no visitors

blocks.original_text:
- name: page_daily_metrics
      description: Daily page-level metrics aligned to a date spine within each page’s active window.
      grain: One row per page_id per date_day (inclusive from created_on through valid_through or today if missing).
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - intermediate.int_pendo__page_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Use the date_day spine from intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine. - For each page in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page, set created_on as the calendar date of created_at; set the window end as the calendar date of valid_through, defaulting to the current timestamp’s date when valid_through is missing. - Build page_spine by keeping (date_day, page) pairs where date_day falls within the inclusive range from created_on through the window end. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__page_daily_metrics to page_spine on matching page_id and where date_day equals occurred_on. - Output page/date attributes from page_spine and metric fields from daily_metrics; when a metric is missing, return 0; other attributes retain their original values including NULLs. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication is performed; multiple matching rows in the source daily_metrics will produce duplicate output rows.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine within the page’s active window (inclusive).
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page identifier from latest_page; used to join daily metrics.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name from latest_page for the active window; NULLs preserved.
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Product area identifier from latest_page; NULLs preserved.
      - name: sum_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total page views for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_first_time_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_first_time_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_return_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning visitors for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_return_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning accounts for the page and date; 0 when missing.
      - name: avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per visitor for the page and date; 0 when missing; no rounding performed.
      - name: avg_daily_pageviews_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average pageviews per visitor for the page and date; 0 when missing; no rounding performed.
      - name: percent_of_daily_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily pageviews attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: percent_of_daily_page_visitors
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily page visitors attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: percent_of_daily_page_accounts
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of total daily page accounts attributed to the page for that date; 0 when missing.
      - name: count_pageview_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of pageview events for the page and date; 0 when missing.

- name: page_event
      description: Page event fact table enriched with previous-event context and page metadata.
      grain: One row per event from staging.stg_pendo__page_event that has a matching page_id in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor
      business_logic: '- Base rows: take all columns from staging.stg_pendo__page_event without de-duplication or aggregation. - Previous-event context: - For each visitor_id, order events by occurred_at ascending. - Attach values from the immediately prior event for the same visitor: previous_page_id, previous_page_event_at, previous_page_num_minutes, previous_page_num_events. - The first event per visitor has NULLs in these fields; if the prior event''s value is NULL, the attached value is NULL. - Ordering uses occurred_at only; if multiple events share the same occurred_at for a visitor, the chosen prior event is not deterministically defined. - Current page enrichment: - Inner join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on page_id to add page_name and product_area_id (from group_id). - Events without a matching page_id are removed. - Previous page enrichment: - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on previous_page_id to add previous_page_name and previous_page_product_area_id (from group_id). - If previous_page_id is NULL or has no match, these fields are NULL. - Left joins to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor and intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account are performed; no columns are selected from them. When those tables are unique by key, row counts are unchanged. - All other staging columns are passed through unchanged; NULLs and duplicates are preserved.'
      columns:

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier passed through from staging; may be NULL.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: num_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Event count from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Minutes from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current page identifier from staging; only events with a matching page in latest_page are retained.
      - name: remote_ip
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Remote IP address from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: server_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Server name from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp used to order events within each visitor for previous-event derivations; ties are not deterministically broken.
      - name: user_agent
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User agent string from staging; passed through unchanged; may be NULL.
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from staging; used to group events for previous-event context; may be NULL.
      - name: page_event_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opaque event key from staging; passed through unchanged; uniqueness not enforced.

        data_type: VARCHAR

        data_type: TIMESTAMP

      - name: previous_page_num_minutes

        description: Minutes from the immediately prior event for the same visitor when ordered by occurred_at ascending; NULL for the first event.
      - name: previous_page_num_events
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: page_name

blocks.original_text:
- name: product_adoption_analytics
      description: Feature adoption aggregates by feature and app with distinct user counts and user-level averages.
      grain: One row per feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, page_name
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event (feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id, num_events, num_minutes, occurred_at)
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_history (feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, created_at, page_id)
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_history (page_id, page_name)
      business_logic: '- Build feature_usage_base from feature_event: - Group by feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id. - Compute per group: usage_sessions (row count); total_feature_events (sum of num_events); total_feature_minutes (sum of num_minutes); first_used_at (earliest occurred_at); last_used_at (latest occurred_at); active_days_with_feature (count of distinct calendar days from occurred_at); avg_events_per_session (average num_events per row); avg_minutes_per_session (average num_minutes per row). Aggregations ignore NULL inputs; distinct counts exclude NULLs. - Build feature_info by left joining feature_history to page_history on page_id: - Select feature_id, app_id, feature_name, is_core_event, feature_created_at, page_id, page_name. Multiple historical rows per feature_id may exist; page_name can be NULL if no page match. - Join and aggregate: - Left join feature_usage_base to feature_info on feature_id. - Group by feature_id, feature_name, is_core_event, page_name, app_id (from feature_usage_base). - Metrics: - total_users_tried: distinct visitor_id in the group (dedup across account_id). - avg_events_per_user: for each user-account pair, sum events across sessions; average that per-pair total across the group. - avg_minutes_per_user: for each user-account pair, sum minutes across sessions; average that per-pair total across the group. - avg_active_days_per_user: for each user-account pair, count distinct calendar days with usage; average that per-pair count across the group. - regular_users: distinct visitor_id with at least one user-account pair having 10 or more active days. - casual_users: distinct visitor_id with at least one user-account pair having 1 to 9 active days. - Duplicate rows from feature_info replicate feature_usage_base rows evenly; distinct counts are unaffected and averages remain the same; metrics may repeat across multiple historical names/pages for the same feature. - calculated_at is the system timestamp at execution and is the same for all rows in a single run.'
      columns:
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pendo feature identifier; part of the grouping key.
      - name: feature_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature name from history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: is_core_event
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Core-event flag from history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name via feature_history.page_id joined to page_history; grouped; may be NULL.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from event data; part of the grouping key.
      - name: total_users_tried
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with any usage in the group; dedup across account_id; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: avg_events_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of total events (sum across sessions) within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: avg_minutes_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of total minutes (sum across sessions) within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: avg_active_days_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per user-account pair of distinct active days within the group; NULLs ignored; no rounding.
      - name: regular_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with at least one user-account pair having 10+ active days; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: casual_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users with at least one user-account pair having 1–9 active days; NULL visitor_id excluded.
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp for the run; identical across all rows in one run.

      description: Feature-level adoption summary by account and app with user/session counts, activity days, adoption category, health score, and calculation timestamp.
      grain: One row per feature_id x account_id x app_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Input: all rows from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event using feature_id, account_id, app_id, visitor_id, num_events, num_minutes, occurred_at. - Group by feature_id, account_id, app_id; produce one row per group. - Metrics: - total_users: number of distinct visitor_id values; NULL visitor_id is ignored; result is zero or greater. - usage_sessions: total number of rows in the group; counts all rows regardless of NULLs in other fields. - total_events: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored; if every num_events is NULL, the sum is NULL. - total_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored; if every num_minutes is NULL, the sum is NULL. - active_days: number of unique calendar days present in occurred_at at day granularity; NULL occurred_at contributes nothing; result is zero or greater. - avg_events_per_session: average of num_events over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - avg_minutes_per_session: average of num_minutes over rows in the group; NULL values are ignored; if all are NULL then the average is NULL; no rounding applied. - adoption_level (evaluated in order) using active_days and total_events: - Power Users: active_days ≥ 20 and total_events ≥ 100 - Regular Users: active_days ≥ 10 and total_events ≥ 50 - Casual Users: active_days ≥ 5 and total_events ≥ 20 - Trial Users: active_days ≥ 1 and total_events ≥ 5 - Minimal Users: all other cases; if total_events is NULL none of the prior thresholds match, yielding Minimal Users. - feature_health_score: calculated as (distinct users × 2) + (average num_events × 5) + (active_days × 3), then capped at a maximum of 100; if there are no non-NULL num_events the score is NULL; no minimum floor and no rounding applied. - calculated_at: set to the current system timestamp at query execution time; value varies per run; no ordering or window functions are used.'

        description: Feature identifier and grouping key.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_id

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier and grouping key.
        tests:

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct users per group; NULL visitor_id excluded; never NULL.
      - name: usage_sessions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total event rows per group; counts all rows; never NULL.

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of num_events; NULLs ignored; NULL if all num_events are NULL.
      - name: total_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Sum of num_minutes; NULLs ignored; NULL if all num_minutes are NULL; units: minutes.'
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique active calendar days from occurred_at at day granularity; NULL occurred_at ignored; never NULL.
      - name: avg_events_per_session
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: avg_minutes_per_session
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average num_minutes per group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all are NULL; not rounded.

blocks.original_text:
- name: visitor_daily_metrics
      description: Visitor-date spine joined to daily metrics from each visitor’s first dated event through the run date.
      grain: One row per visitor_id per date_day in the spine; if multiple daily_metrics rows exist for a visitor_id and date_day, multiple rows are returned.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build a daily calendar spine using date_day from intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine. - From intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics, derive first_event_on per visitor_id as the earliest non-null occurred_on; visitors without any dated events are excluded. - Create a visitor-date spine with one row for each visitor_id on every date_day from first_event_on through the current run date, inclusive. - Left join the visitor-date spine to intermediate.int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics by exact match on visitor_id and date_day to occurred_on. - Select date_day and visitor_id from the spine, and pass through sum_minutes, sum_events, count_event_records, count_pages_viewed, and count_features_clicked from the matched daily_metrics row; no additional aggregation, casting, or rounding is performed. - Null policy: when no daily_metrics row matches a visitor_id and date_day, all metric fields are NULL. - Duplicates: if multiple daily_metrics rows share the same visitor_id and occurred_on, multiple output rows are produced; no deduplication is applied. - Ordering: no explicit sort is applied to the result.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the spine for each visitor from first_event_on through the run date (inclusive).
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from the spine; only visitors with at least one dated event are included.
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Minutes of engagement on date_day from the matched daily_metrics row; NULL when no match.
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Event count on date_day from the matched daily_metrics row; NULL when no match.
      - name: count_event_records
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of event records on date_day from the matched daily_metrics row; NULL when no match.
      - name: count_pages_viewed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Pages viewed on date_day from the matched daily_metrics row; NULL when no match.
      - name: count_features_clicked
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Features clicked on date_day from the matched daily_metrics row; NULL when no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: visitor_feature
      description: Visitor-feature metrics aggregated from raw feature events
      grain: One row per visitor_id + feature_id present in staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event (using visitor_id, feature_id, occurred_at, num_events, num_minutes). - Group by visitor_id and feature_id; emit one row per group. - Compute metrics within each group: - first_click_at: earliest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL. - last_click_at: latest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL. - sum_clicks: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored; result is NULL if all num_events are NULL. - count_click_events: count all rows in the group; NULLs in any field do not affect this count. - sum_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored; result is NULL if all num_minutes are NULL. - count_active_days: number of distinct calendar days derived from occurred_at; determine the day by removing the time component; NULL occurred_at do not contribute; multiple events on the same day are counted once; result is 0 if no non-NULL occurred_at exists. - Compute avg_daily_minutes as sum_minutes divided by count_active_days, rounded to 3 decimal places; result is NULL if count_active_days is 0 or sum_minutes is NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from source; grouping key; NULLs are preserved
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature identifier from source; grouping key; NULLs are preserved
      - name: first_click_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at across the group's events; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: last_click_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at across the group's events; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: sum_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total of num_events across the group's rows; NULL num_events are ignored; result is NULL if all num_events are NULL
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total minutes from num_minutes across the group's rows; NULL num_minutes are ignored; result is NULL if all num_minutes are NULL
      - name: avg_daily_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: sum_minutes divided by count_active_days, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if count_active_days is 0 or sum_minutes is NULL
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar days with non-NULL occurred_at; multiple events on the same day counted once
      - name: count_click_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows per visitor_id + feature_id; counts all rows regardless of NULLs
